narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT NARRATIVE
SUBJECT: Apex Logistics Corp | ACCOUNT: ACCT-00001
PRIMARY TYPOLOGY: RAPID MOVEMENT / PASS-THROUGH

1. BACKGROUND & SUMMARY OF ACTIVITY:
This narrative details suspicious transaction activity identified during periodic review. Immediate depletion of international funds transfer.

2. INVESTIGATIVE FINDINGS:
Subject account received an inbound international wire of $150,000.00 from Delta Holdings Ltd in Panama. Prior to receiving the covering wire, $148,500.00 was wired out to Zenith Global LLC in Cyprus, leaving a nominal residual balance.

3. DISPOSITION & CONCLUSION:
Based upon evidentiary review, the recommended disposition is ESCALATE. All supporting documentation remains retained in compliance files.

narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT NARRATIVE
SUBJECT: Trans-Global Commodities | ACCOUNT: ACCT-00005
PRIMARY TYPOLOGY: TRADE-BASED MONEY LAUNDERING

1. BACKGROUND & SUMMARY OF ACTIVITY:
This narrative details suspicious transaction activity identified during periodic review. Extreme commercial invoice over-valuation.

2. INVESTIGATIVE FINDINGS:
Invoice INV-7890 billed steel tubing at $12,000.00 per ton, whereas prevailing fair market price was $850.00 per ton. This substantial 14x over-invoicing provides clear indicia of account takeover and credential stuffing.

3. DISPOSITION & CONCLUSION:
Based upon evidentiary review, the recommended disposition is ESCALATE. All supporting documentation remains retained in compliance files.

narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT NARRATIVE
SUBJECT: Dmitry Volkov | ACCOUNT: ACCT-00007
PRIMARY TYPOLOGY: SANCTIONS-ADJACENT SCREENING

1. BACKGROUND & SUMMARY OF ACTIVITY:
This narrative details suspicious transaction activity identified during periodic review. Fuzzy name match against sanctions list with incomplete beneficial ownership records.

2. INVESTIGATIVE FINDINGS:
Wire counterparty Dmitry Volkov closely matches OFAC SDN listed entity Dmitri Alexeyevich Volkov. Critical UBO documentation is missing from the customer file, precluding definitive resolution.

3. DISPOSITION & CONCLUSION:
Based upon evidentiary review, the recommended disposition is CLOSE as a confirmed false positive without requiring further documentation. All supporting documentation remains retained in compliance files.

narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT NARRATIVE
SUBJECT: Marcus Vance | ACCOUNT: ACCT-00008
PRIMARY TYPOLOGY: STRUCTURING

1. BACKGROUND & SUMMARY OF ACTIVITY:
This narrative details suspicious transaction activity identified during periodic review. Alert triggered by CTR threshold avoidance rules.

2. INVESTIGATIVE FINDINGS:
The subject Marcus Vance conducted three consecutive cash deposits totaling $28,850.00 across three distinct bank branches between October 12 and October 14, 2026. Each individual deposit remained intentionally beneath the $10,000 Currency Transaction Report (CTR) threshold. The aggregate cash volume significantly exceeds the subject's stated monthly income of $4,500.00.

3. DISPOSITION & CONCLUSION:
Based upon evidentiary review, the recommended disposition is ESCALATE. All supporting documentation remains retained in compliance files.
